exposure: Phenol in distilled water by gavage at daily doses of 15, 30, 60, 120, and 240 mg/kg body weight (b.w.)
cohort: Pregnant female Sprague-Dawley rats were administered phenol from implantation (day 6 post-mating) to day 20 of pregnancy.
finding: Fetal and placental weights decreased as phenol dose increased from 30 mg/kg b.w., suggesting developmental toxicity in the fetuses, and maternal mortality increased in the 60 mg/kg b.w. dose group, indicating maternal toxicity.
birth_weight: Fetal weights were measured on the 20th day of pregnancy.
gest_age: Outcomes were observed on the 20th day of pregnancy.
